bootstrap.method: Paired resampling of entire held-out sequences with replacement; recompute pooled AP50 with fixed confidence tie order.
bootstrap.caveat: 95% percentile intervals are marginal descriptive intervals, not simultaneous or training-seed confidence intervals; no p-values or significance declarations.
